statement: Test a frozen, per-target-layer SWA precision policy choosing existing528B MXFP8 or a new288B NVFP4 record, with compressed cache, weights, window and selection policy unchanged initially.
mechanism: Reduce SWA record traffic and possibly allocated cache bytes; pay changed quantization/dequantization and mixed-layout costs. No native FP4 attention compute acceleration assumed.
proposed_change: Extend exact pinned SWA writer/original-cache reader/spec ABI; reuse existing NVFP4 prefill gather; profile static layer sensitivity separately before freezing a workload policy. Do not change the draft model or turn off AV.
correctness_contract: Target activations change; original target distribution is not guaranteed. Structural codec/cache correctness is separate from downstream quality budget and service evaluation. No universal bitwise rejection and no lossless claim.
selection_rationale: Concrete absent target operation with reusable codecs and a recent static allocation component; sizeable conditional record-byte fraction but unknown exposed time. Retain future experiment pending quality/physical-layout gates, not accepted implementation.
paper_transfer: MultiAlloc static layer allocation only. Original gradient profile requires future model forward/backward, no weight updates. Forward-only ablation is an explicit alternative adaptation, not equivalent paper method. No token-preservation component or donor speed transfer.
